Home.heroSub: Nanaimo Native Victory Church is a Christ-centered community on Vancouver Island, serving and walking alongside the First Nations peoples of this land. We seek healing, restoration, and hope through the love of Jesus Christ, guided by humility, prayer, and genuine relationship.
heroMessages: The gospel journey that began with the First Nations of this land over 60 years ago — we still walk it side by side today.
Where there is woundedness, we pray for the healing and restoration of Jesus Christ.
We carry all 53 nations of Vancouver Island — every name — in prayer.

About.title: Our Church
About.introBody: Nanaimo Native Victory Church is a Christ-centered community on Vancouver Island, serving and walking alongside the First Nations peoples of this land. We seek healing, restoration, and hope through the love of Jesus Christ, guided by humility, prayer, and genuine relationship.
About.visionBody: We are committed to sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ and building God's church among all 53 Indigenous tribes across Vancouver Island. Nanaimo Central Church joins in this vision, partnering in Indigenous ministry throughout Vancouver Island and northern British Columbia.

History.title: History
body: Nanaimo Native Victory Church was founded over 60 years ago by Pastor Carl Miller together with the Nanaimo Indigenous people. At that time, the church was actively involved in reclaiming Indigenous children who were being taken to residential schools, and for decades it has worked for Indigenous rights, welfare, and Indigenous missions.

Nanaimo Native Victory Church is affiliated with The Pentecostal Assemblies of Canada (PAOC), the largest evangelical denomination in Canada and a theologically conservative body. Representative churches within this denomination in the surrounding region include Nanaimo Generation Church, Vancouver Broadway Church, Langley CLA, and Victoria Coastline Church. The PAOC is in sister fellowship with the Yoido Full Gospel Church denomination in Korea and the Assemblies of God denomination in the United States.

Greeting.title: Pastor's Greeting
body: Welcome to Nanaimo Native Victory Church. We are so glad you have found us.

For over sixty years, this church has walked alongside the First Nations peoples of Vancouver Island, seeking healing, restoration, and hope through the love of Jesus Christ. That calling still shapes everything we do today.
Whether you are visiting, searching, or looking for a church home, you are welcome here just as you are. Come and worship with us, and may you experience the grace of God among this community.
